title: Welcome to Laundry Service
excerpt: A first look at the perfectly ordinary laundromat hiding some very unusual ambitions.
body: EDITOR NOTE: This is a suggested first devlog draft. Review and edit it before publishing.
Welcome to Laundry Service, a comedic management game about running a neighborhood laundromat while secretly building an evil lair in the back room.

The everyday work matters: customers need working washers and dryers, drop-off orders have deadlines, and the bills still need to be paid. Meanwhile, behind the scenes, you'll research peculiar equipment, meet a cast of recurring characters, and discover increasingly elaborate Operations.
I'm building Laundry Service in GameMaker. This development log will be where I share new features, screenshots, design decisions, and the occasional unexpected disaster. Thanks for following along!
